scope: Compose the existing homeostasis UI candidate with current source in an isolated JJ workspace; repair false OTP identity; provide reproducible release/manual launchers and local staging/rollback verification. No production effect in this task.

snapshot.reference: Canonical intake a0679e3ddc6cbe22a2b38bfcabacf28378598b39 and isolated composition with bf136217. Listed hashes bind intake, not output.

criticality.rationale: Requested production update is blocked by release identity and recovery evidence.

stpa.rationale: Live endpoint defaults OTP to 29 despite ERTS15 executable; effects need source, authority and rollback checks.

fmea.rationale: S4 O3 Det3 RPN36 gives F4: wrong release can damage service/evidence.

dependency.rationale: Runtime identity, artifact binding and staged rollback are required release predecessors.

impact.rationale: Bounded benefit to one production web service and its native terminal inspection.

fmea_modes.cause: An unbound process or unverified bytecode replaces a live listener.
fmea_modes.effect: Service outage, inconsistent routes or false OTP/admission metadata.
fmea_modes.controls: Exact build manifests, pinned actual OTP29, staging, exclusive lease and tested rollback.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Replace the port-4100 listener with the requested homeostasis update

ucas.context: Required rollback is missing when new listener fails.
ucas.constraint: Prove a rollback listener before touching the old process.

ucas.context: Wrong candidate or wrong process is stopped.
ucas.constraint: Bind effects to manifest, exact PID/start identity and runtime lease.

ucas.context: Shared source or runtime ownership changes during release.
ucas.constraint: Recheck canonical source, lease epoch and target process immediately before effects.

ucas.context: A stopped or unready service persists unnoticed.
ucas.constraint: Bound startup and post-change checks; roll back on failure.

decision.summary: Prepare a reversible, tested update and simple local entrypoints before production effects.
alternatives: Compose, stage, verify rollback and then change only the owned web listener (selected).
counterevidence: The previous UI-only tests do not verify current full-application startup.
The installed web unit is present but no active managed web unit was observed.
assumptions: Operator explicitly requested production update in this turn.
No subagent, peer message or shared mainline mutation is authorized by this side-conversation release.
decision.forecast: Pinned executable identity and staged source manifests should eliminate the observed version mismatch without changing unrelated listeners.
decision.falsifier: The staged service reports a VM version different from its actual executable, loses existing routes, or cannot restore service through the tested rollback.
acceptance: Full web startup and route probe
User-authorized effect-time runtime fencing and post-change verification
decision.rollback: Preserve the current listener until the candidate and fallback are demonstrated. Use retained versioned release configuration to restore the web listener if post-cutover checks fail.
decision.reviewer: Author runtime verification; no independent peer or system-admission claim.
decision.budget: Local-only checks, one release task at a time, bounded staging processes; no provider calls or subagents.
residuals: Physical physiology sources and full interactive TUI host remain separate.
decision.supersedes: Previous UI task did not authorize a release; this is a new user-requested scope.
